summary: The single declaration of the work_start and work_resume branch_freshness result: the closed statuses, the typed failure reasons, the sampled SHA and origin default-ref contracts, and the exact field set each status carries.

default_ref.git_ref_rule: the origin prefix plus a branch name git-check-ref-format accepts: no control character, space, ~ ^ : ? * [ or backslash anywhere, no .., no @{, no leading or trailing slash or double slash, no trailing dot, and no slash-separated component that starts with a dot or ends with .lock
